criteria.name: Algorithm Implementation
criteria.description: All sorting algorithms correctly implemented and tested

levels.label: Complete
levels.description: All sorting algorithms correctly implemented and tested

levels.label: Minor Issues
levels.description: All algorithms implemented with minor bugs

levels.label: Partial
levels.description: Most algorithms work but one or two have significant issues

levels.label: Incomplete
levels.description: Algorithms fail to sort or have syntax errors

criteria.name: Code Quality & Pythonic Style
criteria.description: Use of Python features and code structure

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Excellent use of Python features (list comprehensions, generators, etc.)

levels.label: Good
levels.description: Good code with proper naming and structure

levels.label: Basic
levels.description: Basic functional code but not Pythonic

criteria.name: Test Coverage
criteria.description: Quality and comprehensiveness of test cases

levels.label: Comprehensive
levels.description: Comprehensive test cases including edge cases

levels.label: Good
levels.description: Good test coverage but missing some edge cases

criteria.name: Documentation
criteria.description: Docstrings and comments explaining algorithm logic

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Excellent docstrings and comments explaining algorithm logic
